items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 1 July 2026 4:40pm
items.description:
##Today##

Largely cloudy and dry at first with hill fog and some coastal mist patches along the west coast, then a few outbreaks of rain developing later in the afternoon and evening. Rain clearing later as clear intervals develop.


##Temperature##

##Rainfall (mm):##

1-3


##Wind Speed##

18

SW


##Wind##

W or NW 5-15, soon backing S or SW 20-32, veering W 20-25 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain/drizzle/mist and very poor in fog patches. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds soon developing.
